title: Mehandipur Balaji Dham Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Mehandipur Balaji: ghati mein kya hai?

scenes.prompt: Close-up darshan of the Mehandipur Balaji Hanuman murti: orange-vermilion Hanuman ji as a child-form Bala ji, thickly covered with red sindoor and marigold garlands, a round gentle face, in a quiet sanctum lit by small brass diyas, warm golden glow, face in the middle of the frame
scenes.tts: मेहंदीपुर बालाजी की घाटी में क्या ख़ास है?
scenes.sub: Mehandipur Balaji ki ghati mein kya khaas hai?
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, the golden glow gently pulses

scenes.prompt: A peaceful temple nestled in a green valley between two rocky Aravalli hills in Rajasthan, morning golden light, a stone temple with saffron flags, a few devotees walking up, wide view, no text
scenes.tts: दौसा, राजस्थान में दो पहाड़ियों के बीच बसा धाम।
scenes.sub: Dausa, Rajasthan mein do pahadiyon ke beech basa dham.
scenes.animate: soft clouds drift slowly, saffron flags flutter gently, light shifts across the hills

scenes.prompt: Darshan of the Mehandipur Balaji Hanuman murti, orange-vermilion child-form Hanuman ji, sindoor and marigold garlands, slightly wider view in a sanctum with glowing brass diyas in front, warm golden light
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, बालाजी की मूर्ति पहाड़ी की चट्टान से बनी है।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, Balaji ki murti pahadi ki chattan se bani hai.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, many diya flames flicker softly, a few marigold petals drift in the background

scenes.tts: ॐ श्री हनुमते नमः। अच्छा लगे तो लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय मेहंदीपुर बालाजी!
scenes.sub: Om Shri Hanumate Namah. Achha lage to Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Mehandipur Balaji!
